c27eee5e306d70c875d0161bfbe4cd4bcf22b890: Built on a human scale, Anzère focuses on friendly welcome and proximity rather than impressive figures. Its 58 km of runs are a perfect fit for a 3 to 4 day stay, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Anzère's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a relaxed, easy-going atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Anzère's altitude (1516 m at the bottom, 2420 m at the top) allows it to maintain decent snow cover in the middle of winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it's worth checking conditions before finalising a booking. A stay in Anzère is clearly expensive: a day lift pass costs 72€, on top of accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It's the price of excellence – but it's worth being aware of this before you go. In short: Anzère keeps its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
